title: ATTACH never yields to SEED when every eligible cluster's ring lies in capped districts — growth stalls board-wide despite districts with budget
detail: A cluster whose seed district is under cap (eligible) but whose every legal ring tile sits in capped districts burns all 8 attempts every window; at bias 1000 the coin always picks ATTACH while an eligible cluster exists, so SEED is never reached — growth stalls board-wide though other districts have budget, contradicting "the density ceiling stops growth, never stalls it".
recommended_fix: Fold the drawn-tile district cap into growth_board_cluster_has_room: a cluster is eligible only while some E31-legal, connectable ring tile's OWN district is under its cap.

title: District anchor x/y loaded unvalidated; map_district_assign i32-casts anchor×10 with no bounds guard
detail: Anchors were render-only heritage data; the new partition now feeds them into integer sim math. An off-grid/negative anchor silently mis-partitions the pool; an extreme float overflows the i32 cast (undefined in Odin).
recommended_fix: Fail-fast in map_board_load: validate each district's x/y within [0, w_tiles]×[0, h_tiles] before map_board_partition, like the dims and pool-bounds checks.
